input.quote: Upon termination or expiration of this Agreement, each party shall otherwise return or destroy any Confidential Information of the other party provided, however, Corio may retain any Confidential Information necessary for Corio to continue supporting it's then-existing Customers.
input.rationale: Section 11.3 preserves Corio's continued access rights and Commerce One's surviving support and maintenance obligations, and it addresses return/destruction of Confidential Information, but nowhere in the Agreement (including the Section 12 source code escrow) is there any obligation on Commerce One to provide exit/transition assistance or to return Corio and Customer data held on the MarketSite.net Service in a machine-readable format, or to delete and certify deletion afterwards. No transition or data-export clause exists, so the rule's expected clause is absent in a hosting/services agreement, which the detection guidance treats as an insert. Proposed 11.4 tracks the preferred position (six months' assistance at then-current rates, 30-day machine-readable return, deletion with written certification), with 90 days available as a fallback.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and data return obligations in Section 11 (Term and Termination)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short exit clause requiring Commerce One to provide up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates and to return Corio and Customer data in a machine-readable format within thirty (30) days, then delete and certify deletion. Section 11.3 preserves support and access rights but says nothing about getting our data back, which we need for continuity of service to our Customers; we can work with 90 days of assistance if six months is an issue.

ops.text: 11.4 Transition Assistance and Data Return. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Commerce One shall (a) at Corio's request, provide reasonable transition assistance to Corio and its Customers for a period of up to six (6) months at Commerce One's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Corio's request, return to Corio all Corio and Customer data in Commerce One's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Corio in writing, except to the extent retention is required by applicable law.
